About.p1: Nightkids was born on the streets, fueled by a passion for speed, precision, and the art of the drift.
About.p2: We are not just a racing team; we are a collective of creators, mechanics, and drivers united by the underground car culture. From the mountain passes to the digital screen, we bridge the gap between raw automotive performance and high-octane content creation.
About.p3: Every member brings a unique skill to the table, but we all share the same drive: to push the limits and leave our mark on the asphalt.

Rules.title: Meet Rules
Rules.subtitle: A few simple rules, so we keep finding places to meet up.
items: Respect the highway code on the way there: the meet starts and ends on public roads.
No drifting, burnouts, or dangerous manoeuvres outside authorized areas.
Respect local residents and businesses: no honking or idling engines outside proper hours.
Take your trash with you, leave the place as you found it.
Respect other members and their cars.
Rules.footer: Not respecting these rules puts at risk the places the community can use for future meets.
